summary: Masked settlers stoned occupied Palestinian vehicles; 63-year-old Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur sustained fractures/wounds requiring hospital treatment, his wife fainted, and vehicles were damaged.
discovery_sources: WAFA 20 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 20 Mar 2023; OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023 contextual aggregate
resolution_notes: PLO NAD anchors the event to the evening of March 19 with the same named victim and road; WAFA published just after midnight on March 20 and describes the attack as occurring that night. OCHA independently records a March 19/27 two-incident settler vehicle-stoning lane near Ramallah/Nablus but does not identify each road/victim, so its aggregate is contextual only and is not used to force a one-to-one mapping. Verification remains Partially verified / Medium because Palestinian reporting routes may share local sourcing.
